functions.updateOnMistake: void updateOnMistake(bool wasTimeout) { lives--; mistakes++; playTone(300, 400); if (wasTimeout) { showMessage("TIME'S UP!", "Lives: " + String(lives)); } else { showMessage("WRONG SEQUENCE!", "Lives: " + String(lives)); } delay(800); if (lives > 0) { showMessage("LEVEL RESTART", "New Sequence"); delay(1000); } }
functions.displaySequenceUsingLEDs: bool displaySequenceUsingLEDs() { showMessage("WATCH", "Hold RESET 2s to cancel"); if (!delayWithAbandon(WATCH_PAUSE_MS)) return false; for (int i = 0; i < sequenceLength; i++) { if (checkPhysicalAbandon()) return false; int ledIndex = sequence[i]; digitalWrite(LED_PINS[ledIndex], HIGH); playTone(800, LED_BEEP_MS); if (LED_ON_MS > (unsigned long)LED_BEEP_MS && !delayWithAbandon(LED_ON_MS - LED_BEEP_MS)) { digitalWrite(LED_PINS[ledIndex], LOW); return false; } digitalWrite(LED_PINS[ledIndex], LOW); if (!delayWithAbandon(LED_GAP_MS)) return false; } return true; }
functions.generateRandomSequence: void generateRandomSequence() { if (sequenceLength > MAX_SEQUENCE) sequenceLength = MAX_SEQUENCE; for (int i = 0; i < sequenceLength; i++) { sequence[i] = random(0, 7); } }
functions.checkInput: void checkInput() { totalRounds++; bool inputCorrect = !inputTimedOut; uint32_t incorrectPositionMask = 0; uint8_t pressedAt[MAX_SEQUENCE] = {0}; uint8_t expectedAt[MAX_SEQUENCE] = {0}; for (int i = 0; i < answeredInRound; i++) { if (playerInput[i] != sequence[i]) { inputCorrect = false; incorrectPositionMask |= (uint32_t)(1UL << i); pressedAt[i] = (uint8_t)(playerInput[i] + 1); expectedAt[i] = (uint8_t)(sequence[i] + 1); } } addRoundLog(inputCorrect, inputTimedOut, incorrectPositionMask, pressedAt, expectedAt); // before level changes if (inputCorrect) { updateOnCorrect(); } else { updateOnMistake(inputTimedOut); } showMessage("Score: " + String(score), "Level: " + String(level)); delay(1000); }
functions.addRoundLog: void addRoundLog(bool correct, bool timedOut, uint32_t incorrectPositionMask, const uint8_t* pressedAt, const uint8_t* expectedAt) { if (roundLogCount >= MAX_LOGGED_ROUNDS) { Serial.println("ERROR: round telemetry capacity exceeded"); return; } RoundLog &r = roundLog[roundLogCount++]; r.round = (uint8_t)totalRounds; r.level = (uint8_t)level; r.seqLen = (uint8_t)sequenceLength; r.correct = correct; r.timedOut = timedOut; r.responseMs = (uint32_t)responseTime; r.incorrectPositionMask = incorrectPositionMask; memcpy(r.pressedAt, pressedAt, sizeof(r.pressedAt)); memcpy(r.expectedAt, expectedAt, sizeof(r.expectedAt)); LevelStats &st = levelStats[level]; st.attempted++; if (correct) st.correct++; else st.mistakes++; // failed sequence / timeout count for (int pos = 0; pos < sequenceLength; pos++) { if (incorrectPositionMask & (1UL << pos)) st.incorrectPresses++; } st.sequenceLength = (uint8_t)sequenceLength; st.responseTotalMs += (uint32_t)responseTime; st.responseSamples++; if (st.responseSamples == 1 || responseTime < st.fastestResponseMs) st.fastestResponseMs = (uint32_t)responseTime; if (responseTime > st.slowestResponseMs) st.slowestResponseMs = (uint32_t)responseTime; }
